people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: Of them I will also select priests and Levites,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: “And I will select some of them as priests and Levites,” says the LORD.
translations.kjv: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: And of them also will I take for priests and for Levites, saith Jehovah.
